title: Full Stack Software Engineer
summary: Develop scalable web applications across backend APIs and frontend user interfaces.
key_responsibilities: Design and maintain RESTful microservices and asynchronous backend endpoints
Build responsive, high-performance web interfaces with clean modern standards
Manage relational databases (PostgreSQL/SQLite) and database migrations
Write unit, integration, and end-to-end automated tests
Participate in agile sprints, code reviews, and architectural discussions

title: Senior Python Backend Engineer
summary: Lead the design and implementation of distributed, high-throughput backend services and data pipelines.
key_responsibilities: Architect resilient microservices using Python, FastAPI, and async frameworks
Optimize database queries, indexing, and connection pooling
Implement secure authentication (OAuth2, JWT) and role-based access control
Design message queues with RabbitMQ/Kafka and caching layers with Redis
Mentor junior engineers and champion coding standards

title: Data Scientist
summary: Extract actionable business insights and train predictive machine learning models on complex datasets.
key_responsibilities: Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and feature engineering
Train, evaluate, and fine-tune machine learning models using Scikit-Learn and PyTorch
Build data processing pipelines and deploy inference endpoints
Communicate statistical findings to technical and business stakeholders
Ensure model fairness, reproducibility, and monitoring in production

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Build, deploy, and scale generative AI, LLM agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.
key_responsibilities: Implement vector embeddings, semantic search, and RAG pipelines
Design autonomous AI agent workflows with tool calling and memory systems
Fine-tune pre-trained foundation models for domain-specific tasks
Containerize and deploy AI models with low latency and high reliability
Evaluate LLM outputs using rigorous benchmarking and guardrail frameworks

title: Frontend Web Developer
summary: Craft modern, accessible, and intuitive user interfaces with state-of-the-art web technologies.
key_responsibilities: Transform UI/UX wireframes into responsive, pixel-perfect web pages
Write clean, modular Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3
Optimize web assets for maximum speed, SEO, and accessibility (WCAG)
Integrate backend RESTful APIs and handle asynchronous data flows
Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness

title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
summary: Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring systems.
key_responsibilities: Manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
Deploy and orchestrate containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes
Monitor system health, metrics, and logs with Prometheus and Grafana
Implement zero-trust security practices and compliance standards
